title: Disabling NOC via the settings row while the panel is open leaves the panel stuck ON and D dead
evidence:
app/main.odin:635 `if app.overlay_on {` (the draw gate — no noc_enabled check; the feed scan at :520 `if app.overlay_on && app.run_live {` likewise)
app/main.odin:893-894 `if app.noc_enabled {` / `app.overlay_on = !app.overlay_on` (effect_overlay no-ops while disabled)
app/main.odin:951 `app.noc_enabled = !app.noc_enabled` (the SETTINGS_ROW_NOC case toggles availability without clearing overlay_on)
detail: Reachable sequence: D (overlay_on=true) -> S -> Enter on 'NOC PANEL (D)' (noc_enabled=false) -> close. The draw/scan keep gating on overlay_on alone, so the panel keeps rendering and the per-frame feed scan keeps running, while D is now a no-op — the player cannot dismiss the surface they just disabled.
recommended_fix: Make the gates consistent: in the SETTINGS_ROW_NOC case also clear app.overlay_on when toggling off (or gate the draw + feed scan on `app.overlay_on && app.noc_enabled`), so disabling the feature immediately hides the surface.
